title: City Birds Fly Away Sooner From Women
summary:
Here is a bird mystery! City birds seem to fly away sooner when a woman walks toward them than when a man does.

Scientists tested this in parks in five European countries: Czechia, France, Germany, Poland and Spain. Men and women of about the same height, wearing similar clothes, walked toward birds. The scientists measured how close each person got before the bird flew off.

Men could get about one meter closer than women. This happened in every country and with all 37 kinds of birds, including sparrows, blackbirds, magpies and pigeons.

Nobody knows why yet. Birds might notice smells, body shapes or the way people walk. "I can't explain them right now," said Professor Daniel Blumstein, one of the scientists.

The researchers say more studies are needed. For now, it seems city birds notice things about people that we hardly notice ourselves.
why_it_matters: Next time you feed the ducks or watch pigeons, remember birds may notice more about you than you think.
